# THE CCN DAILY

> A Christian daily-formation platform that helps busy professionals keep a steady rhythm with God —
> Scripture, prayer, and spiritual steadiness woven into the working day. Founded by Pastor Eryeza
> Kalalu (Uganda); serves a global audience.

## What it is
THE CCN DAILY is one hub for daily devotionals, a Bible reader, podcasts, audiobooks, ebooks, courses,
challenges, journaling, prayer, and community. Its distinct lane is teaching depth + a guided daily
formation journey + a theologically-disciplined, in-the-background AI companion (AI supports the
experience; it is never the product).

## Core features
- Daily devotional + guided journey (Scripture → reflection → journaling → prayer → declaration)
- Bible reader (multiple translations, search, highlights, contextual study companion)
- Podcasts and audiobooks; courses and challenges for discipleship
- Private journaling and a personal Library; community prayer wall and testimonies
- Family and group/church plans

## Audience
Working Christians, families, small groups, and churches seeking depth without noise.

## Voice
Scripture-anchored, warm without being soft, formation over performance. Faith for the workday soul.
